title: Sokrates AI Scanner Findings
description: Common output format for all AI scanner skills that enrich a Sokrates analysis.

scanner_version.description: Version of the scanner skill that produced this file

src_root.description: Path to the analyzed source root (the directory evidence file paths are relative to)

summary.description: One-paragraph narrative summary of what the scan found

id.description: Stable unique id: <scanner>/<group>/<slug>. Must not change between runs for the same logical finding.

group.description: Grouping key used to cluster findings in reports, kebab-case

description.description: What was found and why it matters. Self-contained: readable without the evidence.

severity.description: info = neutral fact/inventory item; low..critical = degree of risk or required attention

confidence.description: certain = directly evidenced (e.g. declared in a manifest); likely = strong code-level signals; possible = inferred, weak signals

evidence.description: Verifiable citations. A finding without evidence must either have confidence 'possible' or be grounded in Sokrates data via sokrates_refs (pure-metric findings).

file.description: Path relative to target.src_root, forward slashes

snippet.description: Verbatim fragment from those lines (may be a trimmed sub-fragment; whitespace differences are tolerated by the validator). Keep to <= 5 lines.

recommendation.description: Optional: concrete suggested action, only when severity is above info

sokrates_refs.description: Optional links into the Sokrates analysis, e.g. 'component:codex_rs', 'file:codex-rs/core/src/lib.rs', 'concern:TODOs'
